hazards.control: Pressure test before pumping; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Liner hanger and top packer
function: The tool that suspends the production liner inside the intermediate casing and seals the liner top, when the lateral is completed as a liner rather than a full casing string.

tabs.overview: Run on the liner with a running tool; slips set hydraulically or mechanically to hang the liner weight, cement is pumped, and the top packer is set to seal the liner top. A tieback receptacle above allows a tieback string later. Frac loads through a liner top are a design check.
tabs.engineering: Hanger capacity in liner weight; packer differential rating; expandable and conventional slip designs.
tabs.connections: Liner below; intermediate casing around; tieback above.
tabs.safety: Pressure testing the liner top before the frac.
tabs.evidence: Public plug-and-perf explainer (S20), API Spec 11D1 scope (S21), field practice (S9). Dimensions are public example values, not a manufacturer's design.
tabs.operations: Set once during the well construction.
tabs.failure_modes: Liner top leaks, slips not holding, cement channel at the top.
